units.source_text: 公共汽车绕过稍高的海角，眼前忽然展现一片美丽的色彩——

en.t: As the bus rounded a slightly higher headland, a beautiful burst of color suddenly opened before our eyes—

units.source_text: 海岸这边绵延不绝的山茶林花朵盛开，那边的蜜橘山染上了一片黄澄澄的颜色。

en.t: On this side of the coast, flowers bloomed in endless groves of camellias, while over there the mandarin orange hills were dyed a bright golden yellow.

units.source_text: 一条笔直的路贯穿其间，向下面的海湾伸去。

en.t: A straight road ran through the middle and stretched down toward the bay below.

units.source_text: 海港里整齐美观地停泊着三四十艘渔船。

en.t: In the harbor, thirty or forty fishing boats were moored in neat, handsome rows.

units.source_text: 透过树木的缝隙，只能看见大瓦顶和仓库的白墙。

en.t: Through the gaps in the trees, only large tiled roofs and the white walls of storehouses could be seen.

units.source_text: 在景色宜人的镇上，谁能相信还住着一户像阿雪这样的贫苦人家呢。

en.t: Who would believe that in such a pleasant, scenic town there still lived a poor family like Oyuki's?

units.source_text: 据说这里还是一个不用交税的模范村。

en.t: It was said that this was also a model village where no taxes had to be paid.
